text:
kevin: CI failure on PR #487 after merging new attention kernel. nvcc is producing PTX v6.6 and our downstream assembler/tooling rejects it. also seeing fatbin size jump ~8MB on x86-gpu images. logs attached. :frowning:

ci-bot: build/eng-runtime/nvcc/487 — FAILED in step 'link-fatbin' (exit code 2)
ci-bot: /usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas --target ptx --version reported: 6.6

maria: can you paste the exact nvcc command used in CI? need to reproduce locally. :eyes:

kevin: here is the build line from the failing job:
```bash
nvcc -O3 -gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70 -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode=arch=compute_90,code=sm_90 --ptxas-options=-v -ccbin clang++ -Xptxas=-v -lineinfo -maxrregcount=64 -arch=sm_80 -o build/attention_kernel.fatbin src/attention.cu
```
kevin: the odd bit is we're on CUDA 12.2 image in CI which ships ptx v6.6; our older packaging expects 6.5 and the assembler stage is erroring out. also the fatbin contains both ptx and cubin for each arch so size jumped.

maria: hmm. two separate issues: PTX version mismatch and artifact bloat. For PTX version, can we pin PTX version? nvcc has `--ptx-version` on newer toolchains? not sure.

jordan: quick notes from toolchain: nvcc chooses PTX version based on CUDA toolkit + target arch. There is `-ptx` family flags but behavior changed across nvcc releases. Safer approach is to force code=compute_xx (PTX only) vs code=sm_xx (cubin) ordering, or explicitly pass `--generate-code=arch=compute_80,code=compute_80` to get only PTX for compatibility. :thinking:

suhas: caution — switching everything to compute_xx (PTX-only) can break devices expecting cubin for performance. Some older linkers/tooling expect cubin sections. For our release builds we should produce both, but maybe split CI matrix: one job that builds PTX-only for validator + assembler compatibility, another job that builds optimized cubin artifacts.

alex: pragmatic fix for CI: add a gate that checks ptxas version and fails early with a clear message. e.g. run `ptxas --version` or parse `nvcc --version` and compare to an allowed list. Also adjust flags: drop `-lineinfo` on release to reclaim size, and avoid duplicate arch entries in `-gencode` (we had overlapping entries producing redundant sections).

maria: can we try overriding NVCC output PTX version? I found `--gpu-architecture` vs `--generate-code` differences. Also there's a `-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=[sm_80,compute_80]` style. Maybe CI should set NVCC_PTX_SPEC="code=sm_80,compute_80" env to keep behavior explicit.

kevin: repro notes: locally with CUDA 12.2 docker I reproduced the assembler error: `ptxas fatal : Ptx assembly aborted due to errors`. The error lines point to `PATTERN_MATCH` intrinsics in the new attention kernel that compile down to ptx ops only present in 6.6. So even PTX-only builds will fail on older ptxas.

jordan: okay so kernel uses newer PTX ISA. Options: 1) backport kernel to avoid new PTX instrs (bad), 2) require CUDA 12.2+ in CI and downstream consumers (breaking), 3) add a build step that compiles with `-arch=sm_90` target (so nvcc emits appropriate cubin avoiding PTX-level reliance), or 4) run a small compatibility shim that uses `cuobjdump` to strip offending PTX from fatbin. Tradeoffs exist.

suhas: proposal: Gate CI matrix by CUDA toolkit version. Add a `compatibility` job that runs old-toolchain (CUDA 11.x) build with `PTX-only` target to ensure we stay compatible, and a `release` job that uses CUDA 12.2 to produce optimized cubins. Also add an artifact-size check: fail if a single fatbin > 14MB (configurable).

alex: +1. Also add a quick `ptx-version` lint: compile with `nvcc -dlink --keep`? or post-process with `cuobjdump --dump-ptx` to inspect top-level `.version` directive and assert <= allowed list. I'll add a small python check in CI to parse `cuobjdump` output.

maria: for immediate unblock, kevin can you revert the new intrinsic usage to a guarded macro so we don't emit 6.6-only ptx for now? or retarget to sm_90 explicit codegen so the assembler step doesn't choke. 

kevin: I'll revert intrinsic usage in the kernel to a fallback implementation and open a follow-up to land PTX-6.6 features behind a feature flag and a toolchain bump RFC. For CI changes I'll add:
- CUDA matrix: [11.8, 12.1, 12.2] images
- ptx-version check script (fail with helpful msg)
- artifact size gate (warn on presubmit, fail on release)
- remove `-lineinfo` in release builds

jordan: sounds good. please include a short reproducer script for the infra team so we can add it to the daily CI smoke tests. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: scheduled rerun of job build/eng-runtime/nvcc/487 with tags [cuda-12-2, size-gate] at 1845230400

alex: I'll open a CI MR with the ptx-version checker and artifact-size job. tagging infra and QA. :eyes:

kevin: thanks all — pushing patch with fallback now. will follow up with RFC for toolchain bump.

maria: nice, thanks.
